executive_summary: Canada is experiencing an unprecedented ransomware surge with 104 organizations compromised in the past 48 hours across all sectors. High-profile victims include Canada Goose (retail), National Money Mart (financial services with database leaked), Peterborough Public Health, Workers Health & Safety Centre, Eastern Townships School Board, Municipality of North Perth, and MRC de Maskinongé district. The Qilin ransomware gang leads the attack wave with 21 victims, followed by SafePay (14), Play (12), and Clop (13). Critical infrastructure, healthcare, education, and public sector entities are heavily impacted, indicating a coordinated or opportunistic mass exploitation campaign targeting Canadian organizations.

canada_landscape.summary: Canada is experiencing a severe ransomware crisis with 104 organizations compromised across all provinces and sectors in a 48-hour period. Critical infrastructure targets include public health agencies, municipal governments, school boards, telecommunications providers, and essential services. No CCCS advisories were identified in this reporting period, suggesting this may be an emerging situation requiring urgent federal coordination.
canada_landscape.retailers: Canada Goose (major apparel retailer) compromised by CoinbaseCartel ransomware gang; Active Green + Ross (automotive retail) compromised by Sinobi ransomware gang
canada_landscape.financial: National Money Mart Company (financial services) compromised by Everest ransomware gang with database leaked; Morison Insurance Brokers compromised by Sinobi; Trucash compromised by Lynx; multiple CPA firms and financial service providers affected including Pewarchuk CPA, MG Chartered Professional Accountant, Axion50plus, and reidhurstnagy.com

report_2w.executive_summary: Two critical vulnerabilities demand immediate attention: CVE-2026-45659 affecting Microsoft SharePoint Server and CVE-2026-8451 impacting Citrix NetScaler, both flagged by the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security. North Korean hackers launched the PolinRider campaign, publishing 108 malicious NPM packages, while multiple critical malicious NPM packages were detected in the wild that fully compromise any system on which they're installed. Notable breaches include ShinyHunters claiming 40GB from Nottingham University, AdaptHealth losing patient data via social engineering, and TurkNet suffering a March 2025 breach affecting its ISP customers.

canada_landscape.summary: The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (CCCS) issued two critical alerts: AL26-016 for Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8451 and AL26-015 for Microsoft SharePoint Server CVE-2026-45659. These official advisories indicate immediate patching requirements for Canadian organizations using these platforms. No direct breaches of major Canadian retailers or financial institutions were identified in this period.
